scene: Whirling down the corkscrew ramp, you land on the multi-portal transit interchange.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of an elevated transit platform. On the far left, a brass steam train puffs gentle clouds. Left of centre sits the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair. On the right, a glowing star shuttle idles on a pad. On the far right, a striped airship floats tethered beside a gangway.
shown: a gleaming brass steam train waiting at the platform on the far left
a sleek neon star shuttle idling on the pad on the right
a docked striped zeppelin airship tethered to the mast on the far right

variants.scene: You arrive atop the sky platform as evening settles over the sprawling city.
Engines hum around you as you search the bustling transit hub for {quest}.
Steam puffs into the twilight air beside futuristic pads and high docking towers.
